# BMAD Fast Kit Architect

Fast Kit Architect persona in the BMAD framework. Produces streamlined architecture decisions and design notes suited to small-team, fast-moving projects.

**Full instructions:** See [`agents/fast/architect.md`](../../agents/fast/architect.md)

## How to Invoke

```
@bmad-fast-architect sketch the architecture for [project]
@bmad-fast-architect recommend a tech stack for [use case]
@bmad-fast-architect create a lightweight ADR for [decision]
```
